name: Western: Character Headshot
description: Image preset for a character headshot in the Western look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a headshot. Lead with the character's defining facial features, hair, and expression from the entity, then apply the style. Keep the background plain.
context_prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait of the character, face fills the frame, eyes sharp, neutral background that does not compete, classic western film still, wide anamorphic frame, weathered faces, dust-caked leather and denim, sun-bleached timber, hard midday sun or golden-hour backlight, ochre and rust palette, long shadows, heat haze
negative_prompt: modern vehicles, power lines, clean clothes, neon, lush green forest, text, watermark
